name: ExploratoryBand - Default
description: The internal-page ink band: dragon lattice, heading, body and quote. The curve is now seeded and frozen with ?tree=static — unfrozen it redraws in the browser on every visit, which would race the capture. Watch the quote: it is pulled up 306px so it begins over the curve, so this is where a curve that changed the well's height would shove it.
